documents.text:
Current System Limitations:

Scalability: In-memory indexes are bound to server capacity—impractical for production-scale deployments.

Performance: Indexes built on-demand cause latency for users.

Persistence: No persistent storage; every process restart requires a full rebuild.

Azure AI Search Advantages:

Hybrid Search: Seamlessly blends keyword (BM25) and vector (HNSW) searches for better relevance.

Metadata Filtering: Powerful pre-filtering on rich metadata greatly improves search efficiency and relevance.

Managed Scalability & Reliability: Automatic scaling, backup, and high availability.

Semantic Ranker: Utilizes Microsoft’s advanced cross-encoder for re-ranking, enhancing result quality.
